item.title: One-man Melodic Doom Metal outfit, Orchid Throne, is set to release Buried in Black on January 9, 2026!
item.description: Baltimore (MD) – One-man Melodic Doom Metal outfit, Orchid Throne, is set to release Buried in Black on January 9, 2026!
